reason: The estimate comes from the north-region subsample (N=656 of 2000) with the outcome trimmed at 1% on each side, not the full sample. Both choices were made by the analyst and could change the result, so "no effect" (p=0.15) isn't well supported. The pre-period outcome is controlled and no post-treatment controls are used, but the sample selection is enough to reject. I could not re-run the full-sample check because shell execution was denied.
